registered: see the git commit that added this file (2026-10-05), before the v2 campaign selected a candidate and before any v2 TEST access
candidate: the seed-0 run of the configuration selected by experiments/aerotrack_v2/reports/v2_decisions.json (selection rule in preregistration.json)
test_split: corpus-v2 TEST: Anti-UAV test (91 IR + 91 RGB sequences), CST test (60), Det-Fly test (1,567 images); CST TEST labels verified byte-identical to corpus v1
single_pass: every metric below is computed in ONE pass; final_eval.py refuses a second pass (reports/v2_test_ledger.jsonl)

frozen_before_test.detector: candidate's weights/last.pt (sha256 recorded at the end of training)
frozen_before_test.tracker: experiments/aerotrack_v2/frozen_ste_params.json: STE and argmax parameters tuned on ALL of corpus-v2 VAL by systems/scripts/track_eval.py (maximum mean group mSA), committed before the pass
frozen_before_test.nothing_else: no threshold, parameter or checkpoint is chosen after the pass

metrics.detection: eval_v2.py protocol (cap 5,000 images per dataset): drone AP50 overall / per dataset, CST drone-micro AP50, CST per scene category, mAP50
metrics.sot: single-object-tracking protocol on every Anti-UAV IR / RGB and CST test sequence: mSA = Anti-UAV paper Eq. (1) by Track A's code on the official annotations, per-attribute mSA (Anti-UAV), located rate, false-alarm rate on invisible frames, frames to recover after reappearance; trackers: STE (frozen) and argmax (frozen threshold)
metrics.forecast: systems/scripts/forecast_eval.py metrics on test windows (Kalman vs zero / last / mean velocity; 68 / 95 % ellipse coverage)

comparisons.what: STE mSA vs our faithful GlobalTrack (Track A normal_ir seed 0, test mSA 70.58) on the same 91 Anti-UAV IR test sequences
comparisons.analysis: paired per-sequence difference, sequence bootstrap 95 % CI (B = 2000)
comparisons.claim_rule: 'better than GlobalTrack' only if the CI excludes 0 with a positive mean; 'worse' only if it excludes 0 with a negative mean; else 'no detectable difference'
comparisons.caveat: training data differ: AeroTrack also trains on CST, Det-Fly and Anti-UAV RGB; GlobalTrack on Anti-UAV IR only

comparisons.what: STE mSA on CST test vs the CST benchmark's best published tracker (GlobalTrack retrained on CST, mSA 35.92, arXiv:2507.23473 Table 3)
comparisons.analysis: descriptive only (different implementation, training data and protocol details); no claim beyond the numbers

comparisons.what: STE vs argmax on the same test sequences
detection AP of the candidate vs the generalization series' single test result (gen_temporal_fp_g4_full_e20: CST 0.521, Anti-UAV 0.919, pooled 0.718)
comparisons.analysis: descriptive, unpaired (different training corpus and possibly window)

deployment: the candidate's latency / memory / parity are measured by experiments/deployment/scripts/deploy_gate.py on VAL inputs, never on TEST
